reason: The skin-cell population is already part of this body, and its picture shows how new cells replace surface cells.
expectation: The body will show its skin renewing as some new cells move toward the surface.

alternatives.reason: The signal reaching marrow suggests another route to explore blood renewal.

effect: The body now shows skin renewal, so I can turn to the blood-renewal part of the goal.
reaction: The new cells and shedding make the replacement process clear.
reason: The picture shows the kidney signal travelling in blood to the red-cell precursors in marrow.
expectation: The kidney signal will help the marrow precursors produce red blood cells.

effect: Low oxygen prompts the kidney signal, and the marrow precursors are developing into red cells.
reaction: The connection between oxygen levels and blood renewal is clearer.
reason: The developing red cells belong to the same body, so adding them should continue the blood-renewal goal.
expectation: The body will show its developing red cells contributing to blood renewal.

effect: Skin and blood renewal are complete; the new goal is to remodel existing bone.
reaction: Seeing red cells leave the marrow makes the renewal route clearer.
reason: The bone-removing and bone-forming cells suggest two parts of remodeling, but their order is not clear, so I’ll check the removing cells.
expectation: The compatibility list should show how to begin the bone-remodeling process.

alternatives.reason: Removing cells might act directly on the body's existing bone.

effect: The inspection automatically started remodeling by removing old bone; the forming cells are the likely next step.
reaction: The removal step makes the order clearer.
reason: Bone-forming cells should rebuild the patch where old bone was removed.
expectation: The cells will form new bone in the remodeling patch.

effect: The bone-forming cells rebuilt the patch, completing the remodeling goal and the chapter.
reaction: It was satisfying to see the rebuilt bone alongside the other renewal processes in the same body.

mostWorthwhile.text: Following the kidney signal to developing red cells was most worthwhile: it connected low oxygen to blood-cell renewal in a way I could follow.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the developing red cells to the body felt more like placing a completed piece than making a meaningful decision, although it showed where the cells go.

surprise.text: I was surprised that a low-oxygen cue at the kidney could lead to a signal that helps red cells develop in marrow.

arbitrary.text: The order of bone remodeling was not clear to me initially. The compatibility hint showed that removal came first, and the result made the forming step easier to understand.

continue.text: I would probably continue: connecting everyday ideas like skin shedding to less familiar processes like blood and bone renewal made me curious about what else the body replaces.
